timing: Before actual-data candidate scoring or truth evaluation
truth_eligibility_name: Dominant-support eligible: one family carries at least90% of total load. This permits up to10% load on other supports and does not assert a strict single physical point/contact.
tie_definition: Inference ranks MINIMUM family costs; native/truth labels use MAXIMUM positive family loads. Exact ties in the relevant extremum are flagged; minimum-score ties cannot be confident.
compressive_force: Each candidate must satisfy dot(observer_force,candidate_normal)>=1N; a force-magnitude test alone is insufficient.
dependence: Velocity residual and momentum observer both use measured q/qdot; they are different model constraints, not statistically independent sensor evidence. No calibrated probability claim.
rim_assumption: A rim candidate uses a radial normal as a local single-resultant model assumption. This does not represent all physically admissible edge-contact normals or general two-rim contact.
